papers.title: Does VLA Even Know the Basics? Measuring Commonsense and World Knowledge Retention in Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: The Act2Answer protocol evaluates embodied vision-language-action models by having agents answer questions through physical actions, revealing knowledge retention and generalization patterns across different semantic categories.

papers.title: SkillHone: A Harness for Continual Agent Skill Evolution Through Persistent Decision History
papers.abstract: This framework enables continuous evolution of agent skills by maintaining persistent decision histories and incorporating practice feedback for improved performance across research and analysis tasks.

papers.title: Managing Procedural Memory in LLM Agents: Control, Adaptation, and Evaluation
papers.abstract: Procedural memory enhances LLM agents on workplace tasks through skill transfer across roles and models, with varying generalization capabilities affecting deployment strategies in production agent platforms.

papers.title: DataEvolver: Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Data Construction for Text-Rich Image Generation
papers.abstract: A self-evolving multi-agent framework improves text-rich image generation by leveraging feedback from rejected samples to iteratively enhance data quality and semantic alignment in visual outputs.

papers.title: Are We Measuring Strategy or Phrasing? The Gap Between Surface- and Approach-Level Diversity in LLM Math Reasoning
papers.abstract: Research reveals that approach-level diversity in mathematical reasoning differs from surface-level metrics, exposing challenges in directly optimizing diverse reasoning approaches for language models.

papers.title: QVal: Cheaply Evaluating Dense Supervision Signals for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
papers.abstract: A training-free testbed evaluates dense supervision signals for long-horizon agent tasks by measuring Q-alignment, enabling fair comparison of different supervision approaches without requiring training runs.

papers.title: Play2Perfect: What Matters in Dexterous Play Pretraining for Precise Assembly?
papers.abstract: This reinforcement learning framework enables sample-efficient robotic assembly tasks by first learning general manipulation skills through playful interaction, then adapting for precise assembly through fine-tuning.

papers.title: Unlocking the Visual Record of Materials Science: A Large-Scale Multimodal Dataset from Scientific Literature
papers.abstract: A pipeline processes compound scientific figures into individual panels with structured annotations, creating a comprehensive dataset for vision-language learning in materials science applications.

papers.title: TRIAGE: Role-Typed Credit Assignment for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: A framework enhances agentic reinforcement learning by providing nuanced credit assignment beyond standard methods, improving success rates across multiple benchmarks through semantic role classification.

papers.title: MOPD: Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation for Capability Integration in LLM Post-Training
papers.abstract: On-policy distillation enables efficient integration of multiple domain capabilities in large language models through specialized reinforcement learning teachers, achieving superior capability inheritance.

cc_updates.body: Claude in Chrome is now generally available. Added background agent notifications with Notification hook (agent_needs_input/agent_completed). Added /dataviz skill for chart design. Gateway: added Claude Platform on AWS as upstream provider. Background agents now commit, push, and open draft PR when finished. Built-in Explore agent inherits main session's model. Subagents inherit extended thinking config. Fixed brief network drops mid-response with retry backoff. Fixed excessive background classifier requests. Fixed background tasks getting stuck.

Introducing Claude Sonnet 5: now the default model in Claude Code, with a native 1M-token context window and promotional pricing of $2/$10 per Mtok through August 31. Update to version 2.1.197 for access.

Added support for organization default models in org console. Added readable default session names. Added clickable file attachments in chat with Cmd/Ctrl-click reveal. Security: claude mcp list/get no longer spawn untrusted .mcp.json servers. Fixed background job transcript probe. Improved /code-review token usage 25%.
